newsitem.title: USA: Sunbeam sees double digit sales growth.
newsitem.headline: Sunbeam sees double digit sales growth.

text.p: Sunbeam Corp said Wednesday it expected double digit sales growth for the balance of the year.

"I believe that the toughest quarterly comparison is now behind us," said Sunbeam chief executive Al Dunlap. "I look forward to a continuation of these remarkable financial results, including strong double digit sales growth, during the balance of the year as we accelerate introduction of new products such as the soft serve ice cream maker, a high-end gas grill line and some from our secret product room."

Sunbeam said earnings per share from continuing operations of $0.30 were 900 percent ahead of the $0.03 reported in the second quarter of 1996. On a year to date basis, revenue of $541.1 million was 14.7% above 1996, on a comparable basis, and earnings per share from continuing operations of $0.54 were 391% above the $0.11 reported in 1996.

"These financial results show that we have accelerated the growth experienced in the first quarter of 1997, and they validate our strategy to divest non-core businesses, rationalize SKU's and focus like a laser on growing core businesses." said Dunlap.

"Contrary to views that this is a slow-growth industry, if you introduce innovative products and get them to market on time, this can be an outstanding business with great returns for shareholders," he said.

Mr. Dunlap attributed the second quarter sales results to strong increases in the company's global appliance and outdoor cooking categories which comprised about 80 percent of Sunbeam's sales in the quarter.
